summary: Phase 16 iter411 · /dispatch-portal IA refactor verified end-to-end via Playwright at desktop (1280px) and mobile (390px). All 7 operational-flow sections render in order with correct testids. Top blue bar carries ONLY orientation testids (home/back/logout) — header text does NOT contain Transfers/Live Board/Fleet/Drivers. Operational Attention loads /api/dispatch/governance/findings and renders ds-attention-cards with the 3 sub-cards (breakdown/stuck/longwait). All 4 Issue Work tiles open the SAME AssignmentCreateDrawer with the correct haul_type preselected (orange-active confirmed on ac-haul-type-material, ac-haul-type-equipment-move, ac-haul-type-tanker-liquid-asphalt, ac-haul-type-support-misc). Tanker tile reveals ac-tanker-source/ac-tanker-destination/ac-liquid-product. Equipment-Move tile reveals ac-equipment/ac-pickup/ac-dropoff. dispatch-board-link → /dispatch-portal/board preserved. Follow-Through Tabs (dh-tab-transfers, dh-tab-holds) and Secondary Operations Tabs (dh-tab-overview/utilization/idle/integrations) render with original content. Footer links (dispatch-fleet-link, dispatch-driver-qual-link, dispatch-asset-transfers-link) point to correct routes. 5 GuideTiles + dispatch-training-link present. Mobile 390 has no horizontal scroll, grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 on Issue Work, sections stack single-column. ESLint clean on DispatchHub.jsx and AssignmentCreateDrawer.jsx. Bilingual confirmed when masci.lang=es in localStorage — drawer shows 'Cisterna / Asfalto Líquido' and full ES vocabulary.

issues: Cultural 'Memorial Day' sticky banner (data-testid=hub-banner-strip-cultural) intercepts pointer events across the page. Not a Phase 16 regression (cross-hub announcement element), but worth noting that the banner CAN block clicks on underlying tiles until dismissed — only force=True clicks bypass it. End users would need to dismiss the banner once to interact normally.

critical_code_review_comments: AssignmentCreateDrawer initialHaulType prop wiring is correct — useEffect deps [open, initialHaulType] correctly re-seeds setHaulType when a different Issue Work tile is clicked while the drawer remains open across re-opens.

i18n setup uses localStorage `masci.lang` toggled by LangToggle component — there is NO URL-param-based language route (?lang=es is not honored by /lib/i18n.js). The Phase 16 acceptance line 'Bilingual (?lang=es) preserved' is a doc-only inconsistency; the bilingual capability itself works correctly. If URL-param-based lang routing is desired, add a useEffect that calls setLang(urlSearchParams.get('lang')) on mount.

DispatchHub.jsx is 559 LOC (close to the 700-line guideline) — still readable since sub-components (Section, AttentionCard, IssueButton, GuideTile) live at the bottom of the same file. Could be extracted to /components/dispatch/hub/* for maintainability but no functional concern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 16 IA refactor of /dispatch-portal verified clean. All 7 ds-section-* testids, top-bar orientation testids, 4 Issue Work tiles with preselected haul_type, Follow-Through and Secondary Operations tabs, footer links, and Guides tiles all present and functional. Tanker/Equipment-Move conditional fields render correctly. Mobile 390 layout clean (no h-scroll, grid-cols-2 on tiles). Spanish i18n verified when masci.lang=es is set in localStorage. Memorial Day cultural banner is a separate hub-wide element (testid hub-banner-strip-cultural) — unrelated to Phase 16 but it does intercept clicks until dismissed. Backend parity-lock not retested (frontend-only refactor, zero backend changes per Phase 16 doctrine; main agent reports 122/122 per-file pass with the documented inherited pytest tenant-isolation flakiness on cross-file runs).
